async def act(page):
    # Click the 'Most stars' link to sort projects by stars
    await page.get_by_role('link', name='Most stars').click()
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)  # Wait for the page to update
    
    # Fill the search box with 'Covid' to filter projects
    await page.get_by_role('searchbox', name='Filter by name...').fill('Covid')
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)  # Wait for search results to appear
    
    # Click the first project link that appears (assuming it's the most starred Covid project)
    project_link = page.get_by_role('heading', level=2).first.get_by_role('link')
    await project_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)  # Wait for the project page to load
    
    # Find and print the SSH clone URL (SSH URLs typically start with 'git@')
    clone_url_element = page.get_by_text('git@', exact=False)
    clone_url = await clone_url_element.text_content()
    print(clone_url)

async def act(page):
    # Click the 'Most stars' link to sort projects by stars
    await page.get_by_role('link', name='Most stars').click()
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)  # Wait for the page to update

    # Fill the search box with 'Covid' to filter projects
    await page.get_by_role('searchbox', name='Filter by name...').fill('Covid')
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)  # Wait for search results to appear

    # Click the first project link that appears (assuming it's the most starred Covid project)
    project_link = page.get_by_role('heading', level=2).first.get_by_role('link')
    await project_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)  # Wait for the project page to load

    # Find and print the SSH clone URL (SSH URLs typically start with 'git@')
    clone_url_element = page.get_by_text('git@', exact=False)
    clone_url = await clone_url_element.text_content()
    print(clone_url)
    return clone_url
